title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A classic Uruguayan recipe featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: beef (skewerable cut, e.g. sirloin or ribeye)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add beef cubes to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until beef reaches a safe internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
